for item in _items:
    job = item["json"]

    company = job.get("company", "")
    letter = job.get("corrected_cover_letter", "")

    if company == "Benzinga":
        letter = letter.replace(
            "Navigating the trade-offs between model accuracy and inference latency for API delivery was a **CHARMINGLY** complex challenge. By focusing on efficient model packaging and monitoring, I worked to ensure the system remained performant under varying conditions.",
            "My DistilBERT sentiment analysis project gave me practical experience developing and evaluating NLP models. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss these projects in more detail."
        )

    if company == "AlgaeCal":
        letter = letter.replace(
            "This ensures that the models I develop are robust, monitored, and structured for real-world application.",
            "This experience has strengthened my understanding of model deployment, validation, and monitoring."
        )

    results.append({
        "json": {
            "rank": job.get("rank"),
            "company": company,
            "title": job.get("title"),
            "location": job.get("location"),
            "match_score": job.get("match_score"),
            "recommendation": job.get("recommendation"),
            "application_url": job.get("application_url"),
            "location_eligibility": "Unverified - confirm employer hiring restrictions",
            "final_cover_letter": letter,
            "application_status": "Draft - not submitted",
            "review_required": True,
            "source": job.get("source")
        }
    })

return results

# Collect existing application URLs from Google Sheets
existing_urls = set()
new_jobs = []
seen_new_urls = set()

for item in _items:
    record = item["json"]
    url = str(record.get("Application URL", "") or "").strip().lower()

    if url:
        existing_urls.add(url.rstrip("/"))

# Keep only original jobs not already in Google Sheets
for item in _items:
    record = item["json"]
    url = str(record.get("application_url", "") or "").strip().lower().rstrip("/")

    if url and url not in existing_urls and url not in seen_new_urls:
        new_jobs.append({"json": record})
        seen_new_urls.add(url)

return new_jobs
